title: Re-evaluate business unlock eligibility after repository-protection remediation
objective: Bind the manually remediated live main-branch ruleset to an explicit machine-readable eligibility verdict while keeping business/runtime authority unchanged and requiring a separate explicit human-authorized unlock transition.
non_goals: merge modify remediate or adopt Lot45
change runtime execution authority permission to trade leverage or withdrawals
rewrite the WU01 blocked decision or immutable ENG-00 baseline
mutate Development Engine V1 certification or frozen interface
introduce paid services or mandatory LLM review

forbidden_semantics: Lot45 merge mutation remediation or adoption

required_invariants: the historical WU01 BLOCKED_NO_UNLOCK decision remains byte-preserved and valid as the pre-remediation checkpoint
live eligibility is proven from fresh GitHub branch PR and full normalized ruleset semantics rather than by editing canonical ENG-00 observations
an accepted active ruleset must cover refs/heads/main and include deletion non_fast_forward pull_request and required_status_checks rules
required status checks must include Gitleaks pinned CLI CodeQL Python security-extended and quality
ruleset bypass actors must be empty and current_user_can_bypass must be never
branch resource protected must be true and PR66 head/base/state/merged facts must remain unchanged
eligibility verdict grants permission to perform a later explicit unlock transition but does not itself activate business or runtime authority
Lot45 remains SUSPENDED_CANDIDATE Lot46 remains LOCKED and trade/execution remain fail-closed
any later change to main candidate or normalized ruleset invalidates the evidence and requires explicit re-evaluation
acceptance_criteria: snapshot eligibility validator passes against the persisted post-remediation evidence
GitHub-live eligibility validator exactly matches main PR66 and normalized ruleset semantics
ruleset compliance verifies all five repository-protection floor requirements
strict status-check mode approvals and review-thread resolution are recorded but are not required by the current protection floor
validator rejects disabled/evaluate enforcement missing main scope missing PR rule missing status rule missing required check missing deletion/non-fast-forward rule or any bypass actor
validator rejects business activation Lot45 merge permission Lot46 unlock or runtime/trading authority in the eligibility evidence
Engineering Bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the exact integration head

done_when: manual repository-protection remediation is independently proven compliant
eligibility is explicit reproducible and live-bound
a separate explicit human-authorized transition is still required for any actual business unlock
